description: This file implements a simple in-memory rate limiting middleware class for a web application, built using the Starlette ASGI framework. It provides functionality to limit requests based on IP address within specified time windows.

classes.name: RateLimitMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware for limiting the number of requests per IP address within a specified time window, using in-memory counters.

methods.name: __init__(self, app, rate: str = "100/minute")
methods.description: Initializes the rate limiting middleware with application and rate string, setting up allowance tracking and parsing the rate.

methods.name: _parse_rate(self, rate: str)
methods.description: Parses a rate string such as '100/minute' into numerical request count and time window in seconds.

methods.name: dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next)
methods.description: Handles each incoming request, tracks counts per IP and window, and returns 429 response if limit exceeded, otherwise proceeds with request.

ctags.name: dispatch
ctags.pattern: /^    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next):$/
